title: Playground
subtitle: Create visual cipher credentials or scan and match physical objects in real-time to unlock secret messages.

create.title: Create Visual Cipher Credential
create.desc: Upload a clear reference photo of a physical object (book cover, painting, figurine, etc.) and enter your secret. Features will be extracted client-side.
create.secretPlaceholder: Enter the text, password, or confidential note you wish to protect...
create.memoPlaceholder: e.g., Coffee shop table doodle / Book on 3rd shelf
create.tip: Tip: Use well-lit, richly-textured objects. Raw images never leave your browser.

result.title: Credential Ready
result.passcodeDesc: Recipients can enter this passcode or scan the QR code to begin verification.

poster.title: Customize Share Poster
poster.desc: Drag and resize the QR code overlay, then export high-resolution share posters.

read.title: Scan & Physical Matching
read.subtitle: Scan a passcode QR code or enter it manually, then point your camera at the physical object to decrypt in real time.
read.scanningHint: Align viewfinder with the QR code or passcode on the poster
read.matchingHint: QR code recognized! Now align camera with the physical reference object...
read.alignObject: Please align camera with the physical object
read.cameraError: Camera initialization error. Please check permissions or device.
read.orUploadImage: Or upload an image from album
